personality_one_liner: A premium, energetic social network for financial traders that feels cinematic, exclusive, and precise.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for premium feel. Feed cards should have md margin to stand out from the canvas.

do's: Use glass on sticky headers over scrolling content
Use glass on bottom tab bar
Use glass for Premium feature teaser cards layered over background art
dont's: Never apply glass to text form fields
Don't stack more than 2 glass surfaces per screen

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Sign up, login, and onboarding carousel.
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with a heavy gradient scrim (transparent to surface color at the bottom). Form fields inside surfaceSecondary containers with subtle border. Primary CTA spans full width at the bottom.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Main social feed featuring posts with media, likes, and a stories row.

states.empty: Abstract graphic + 'Follow traders to see their updates' + CTA

screens.layout: Glassmorphism sticky header. Top horizontal scroll for Stories (circular avatars with brandPrimary rings). Vertical feed of cards using surfaceSecondary, md border radius, containing header (avatar/name), content, optional media, and action row (Phosphor icons: heart, chat, share, bookmark).

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Trader profile displaying metadata, stats, and a tabbed media feed.

states.empty: No posts yet message with empty state illustration

screens.layout: Cover image with vertical gradient scrim at bottom. Profile avatar overlapping cover. Stats row (Followers, Following). Chips for Markets and Trading Style. Sticky tab bar (Posts, Photos, Videos, Mentions, Saved) using glassmorphism. Content renders below based on active tab.

screens.name: Chat
screens.purpose: List of direct messages and individual conversation screen.

states.empty: 'No messages yet' illustration + 'Start a conversation' CTA

screens.layout: List view for inbox (avatar, name, last message, time). Conversation view with surfaceTertiary bubbles for incoming, brandTertiary bubbles for outgoing. Sticky bottom input with keyboard-avoiding behavior.

screens.name: Create Post
screens.purpose: Modal to compose text, upload media, or select a GIF.
screens.layout: Full screen modal with top actions (Cancel, Post). Large text area. Bottom toolbar for adding photos, videos, or GIFs.

screens.name: Premium
screens.purpose: Teaser hub for upcoming premium sections.
screens.layout: Hero image using abstract neon grid background with gradient scrim. 3 large Glass cards (Single & Mingle, Accountability Partners, Trading Only) with lock icons and descriptive text.

chart_screenshot.alt: Dark mode financial trading chart screen

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 500 font-weight maximum rule. Use font size to establish hierarchy instead of bold weights. Ex: Heading at 24pt (500), Body at 14pt (400 or 500).

Implement the user-requested palette (near-black/navy backgrounds with electric purple, cyan, blue, silver accents) strictly. Do not use generic AI blue; use the specific hex codes provided in this JSON.
Use a gradient scrim (from transparent to at least 70% surface opacity) whenever text is placed on top of an image. Ensure the text uses onSurfaceInverse for maximum readability.
For the Profile screen, build a segmented control for the tabs (Posts, Photos, Videos, Mentions, Saved) that sticks below the profile header using a glassmorphism effect.
Implement the 'Stories' row on the Home feed as a horizontally scrolling list of circular avatars bordered with brandPrimary color.
Use Phosphor icons consistently across the app. Do not use emojis in the UI.
Wire up haptics per the haptics block (tab clicks, liking posts, sending messages).
